ruleset.name: prudent
ruleset.description:
Prudent's own PMD ruleset — deliberately ONE rule, not a suite. See maven-pmd-plugin's binding in server/pom.xml for why: a build that fails on a style rule needs the rule to be legible from the failure alone, and a ruleset importing an entire PMD category (correctness, performance, ...) would fail the build on things nobody asked this check to catch.
UnnecessaryFullyQualifiedName flags exactly `prudent.account.AccountBalance(...)` used inline instead of `import prudent.account.AccountBalance;` plus the simple name — a fully qualified reference where an import would resolve the same class. It found one real instance on introduction (server/src/test/java/prudent/UserScopingTest.java), which is why the rule exists rather than an assumption that the codebase was already clean.
